bullets.text: Connected Britain Awards 2025 Winners - **Three UK** and **Lightning Fibre** excel in digital innovation and customer service.
Ciena Acquires Nubis for $270M - The acquisition enhances **Ciena**'s capabilities in AI-related data center connectivity.
VodafoneThree Chooses Nokia and Ericsson - **VodafoneThree** drops **Samsung** for a £2bn network upgrade.
AI Pathfinder Invests £18.4 Billion - New data centers in Northamptonshire and Ayrshire aim to boost UK digital infrastructure.
Gigaclear Adopts Vyntelligence AI - **Gigaclear** enhances rural broadband installations with innovative AI technology.
Verizon Forms 6G Alliance - **Verizon** collaborates with industry leaders to shape the future of 6G technology.
Fatalities Linked to Optus Outage - **Optus** faces scrutiny after a network failure impacted emergency services.
Netomnia Rebrands for Growth - **Netomnia** aims to reflect its ambitions in the UK fibre market with a new identity.
AI Traffic System Launched in Malaysia - **CelcomDigi** partners with government to optimize urban traffic management using AI.
Data Centre Operators Face Power Demand Surge - AI workloads are driving unprecedented growth in data centre power needs.
